entries.speaker: wren_ward
entries.shown: [low] The druids wanted this mine shut down too.
entries.text: [low] The druids wanted this mine shut down too.
entries.before: [low] The wood people wanted this place shut as badly as we do.

entries.speaker: wren_ward
entries.shown: [dry] We could have had their help. Instead, we picked a fight with them. That was clever of us.
entries.text: [dry] We could have had their help. Instead, we picked a fight with them. That was clever of us.
entries.before: [dry] We fought them for the right to walk past it. I keep turning that over and it keeps coming out stupid.

entries.speaker: cassian
entries.shown: [hesitant] The training yard was easy. You knew the other man would stop.
entries.text: [hesitant] The training yard was easy. You knew the other man would stop.

entries.speaker: cassian
entries.shown: [honest] In a real fight, I still want to run. I worry that one day I will.
entries.text: [honest] In a real fight, I still want to run. I worry that one day I will.

entries.speaker: cassian
entries.shown: [relieved] Thank you. I needed to hear that from someone who had actually seen me fight.
entries.text: [relieved] Thank you. I needed to hear that from someone who had actually seen me fight.

entries.speaker: cassian
entries.shown: [easier] I wrote home. Mostly about the people I have met. My mother would worry if I described the fighting.
entries.text: [easier] I wrote home. Mostly about the people I have met. My mother would worry if I described the fighting.

entries.speaker: cassian
entries.shown: [fond] She runs a bakery. I used to get up before dawn to carry flour. I complained every morning. Now I miss it.
entries.text: [fond] She runs a bakery. I used to get up before dawn to carry flour. I complained every morning. Now I miss it.

entries.speaker: cassian
entries.shown: [warm] There is a stool by the oven where I used to sleep between deliveries. Mother still keeps it there. She says my room is too far from the work.
entries.text: [warm] There is a stool by the oven where I used to sleep between deliveries. Mother still keeps it there. She says my room is too far from the work.

entries.speaker: cassian
entries.shown: [shy] I would like that too. May we take a little time? I want to know you better.
entries.text: [shy] I would like that too. May we take a little time? I want to know you better.

entries.speaker: cassian
entries.shown: [gentle] Of course. Tell me when you are ready. We can still enjoy each other's company.
entries.text: [gentle] Of course. Tell me when you are ready. We can still enjoy each other's company.

entries.speaker: cassian
entries.shown: [nervous] I enjoy the time we spend together. More than I know how to say properly.
entries.text: [nervous] I enjoy the time we spend together. More than I know how to say properly.
entries.before: [stumbling] I have written this out four times and burned it three. I — {target}. With respect. I have not stopped looking at you since the wolves, and I am not the sort who looks.

entries.speaker: cassian
entries.shown: [earnest] When we have a quiet evening, may I take you to supper? Just the two of us.
entries.text: [earnest] When we have a quiet evening, may I take you to supper? Just the two of us.
entries.before: [earnest] If the Order asks, I will say it was duty. It was not.

entries.speaker: cassian
entries.shown: [pleased] Supper, then. I know a decent place. I will try to get through the evening without saluting you.
entries.text: [pleased] Supper, then. I know a decent place. I will try to get through the evening without saluting you.
entries.before: [overwhelmed] Truly? I — yes. Yes. God keep you. I will be very good at this — I will try very hard to be good at this, I promise.

entries.speaker: selene
entries.shown: [warm] You're family, honey. You don't have to face this alone. Get some rest. We leave for Lanternhold in the morning.
entries.text: [warm] You're family, honey. You don't have to face this alone. Get some rest. We leave for Lanternhold in the morning.

entries.speaker: ithrel
entries.shown: [low] I have spent so long following tracks that I have given little thought to what comes after.
entries.text: [low] I have spent so long following tracks that I have given little thought to what comes after.

entries.speaker: ithrel
entries.shown: [tired] I cannot go back to the life I had with my wife. I do not yet know what else I want.
entries.text: [tired] I cannot go back to the life I had with my wife. I do not yet know what else I want.

entries.speaker: ithrel
entries.shown: [quiet] I would like to stay. It helps to have people expecting me back.
entries.text: [quiet] I would like to stay. It helps to have people expecting me back.

entries.speaker: ithrel
entries.shown: [thoughtful] I used to guide travellers through the woods. Some had never slept outside. They would wake me over every rustle.
entries.text: [thoughtful] I used to guide travellers through the woods. Some had never slept outside. They would wake me over every rustle.

entries.speaker: ithrel
entries.shown: [faintly amused] One paid me extra to keep the owls away. I gave him something to plug his ears.
entries.text: [faintly amused] One paid me extra to keep the owls away. I gave him something to plug his ears.

entries.speaker: ithrel
entries.shown: [warm] I would enjoy that. There are places worth visiting without a bounty to collect.
entries.text: [warm] I would enjoy that. There are places worth visiting without a bounty to collect.

entries.speaker: ithrel
entries.shown: [careful] I care for you. I need time before I can promise more. If you are willing to wait, I would like to try.
entries.text: [careful] I care for you. I need time before I can promise more. If you are willing to wait, I would like to try.

entries.speaker: ithrel
entries.shown: [calm] Take the time you need. You know where to find me.
entries.text: [calm] Take the time you need. You know where to find me.

entries.speaker: ithrel
entries.shown: [low] I still miss my wife. I always will.
entries.text: [low] I still miss my wife. I always will.
entries.before: [low] I buried the last person I loved beside a road. I said I would not do this again.

entries.speaker: ithrel
entries.shown: [quiet] But I have come to care for you too. If you feel the same, I would like us to be together.
entries.text: [quiet] But I have come to care for you too. If you feel the same, I would like us to be together.
entries.before: [quiet] I would, though. With you. I wanted you to know it before the city, in case the city is the end of me.

entries.speaker: ithrel
entries.shown: [quiet] Then we will take our time. I am glad you told me.
entries.text: [quiet] Then we will take our time. I am glad you told me.
entries.before: [exhaling] Then I will try to live through the city. That is new. Thank you for giving me a reason.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [direct] I appreciate what you did for me. Understand something, though. You did not buy my loyalty by keeping me alive.
entries.text: [direct] I appreciate what you did for me. Understand something, though. You did not buy my loyalty by keeping me alive.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [firm] I choose where I go and whom I serve.
entries.text: [firm] I choose where I go and whom I serve.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [approving] Good. I prefer travelling with someone who understands that.
entries.text: [approving] Good. I prefer travelling with someone who understands that.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [unguarded] I miss the quiet of the shrine. Before the petitions began, I had an hour to myself.
entries.text: [unguarded] I miss the quiet of the shrine. Before the petitions began, I had an hour to myself.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [dry] Up here, someone is always shouting, selling something, or telling me what a lovely morning it is. Usually in the rain.
entries.text: [dry] Up here, someone is always shouting, selling something, or telling me what a lovely morning it is. Usually in the rain.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [measured] The work was demanding. I liked that. I knew what was expected of me, and I was good at it. I miss having a place of my own.
entries.text: [measured] The work was demanding. I liked that. I knew what was expected of me, and I was good at it. I miss having a place of my own.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [interested] You have my attention. Let us spend more time together before deciding anything.
entries.text: [interested] You have my attention. Let us spend more time together before deciding anything.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [level] Then leave it for now. You can bring it up when you know what you want.
entries.text: [level] Then leave it for now. You can bring it up when you know what you want.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [dry] I enjoy your company when you stop trying to give me orders.
entries.text: [dry] I enjoy your company when you stop trying to give me orders.
entries.before: [dry] Do not look so alarmed. I am not asking you to love me; your people are terrible at it.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [direct] I would like some time alone with you. Interested?
entries.text: [direct] I would like some time alone with you. Interested?
entries.before: [soft] I am telling you that I have decided to stay, and that when you sit in that chair I mean to be standing beside it. By the deep, make of that what you will.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [pleased] Good. Come and sit with me. Your duties can wait for an evening.
entries.text: [pleased] Good. Come and sit with me. Your duties can wait for an evening.
entries.before: [satisfied] Good. You will not regret it, and if you do, I will mend that.

entries.speaker: ilvara
entries.shown: [cool] Very well. I will not ask again.
entries.text: [cool] Very well. I will not ask again.
entries.before: [shrugging] As you like. The offer keeps. I am patient in a way your kind is not.

entries.speaker: faelen
entries.shown: [quieter] I know I make a performance of everything. It is easier than admitting I was scared.
entries.text: [quieter] I know I make a performance of everything. It is easier than admitting I was scared.

entries.speaker: faelen
entries.shown: [honest] When you found me, I thought I was going to die there. I have been sleeping badly since.
entries.text: [honest] When you found me, I thought I was going to die there. I have been sleeping badly since.

entries.speaker: faelen
entries.shown: [soft] Thank you. I might be rather poor company tonight, but I would like you to stay.
entries.text: [soft] Thank you. I might be rather poor company tonight, but I would like you to stay.

entries.speaker: faelen
entries.shown: [cheerful] I used to play for supper at roadside inns. I know six songs well and about forty badly.
entries.text: [cheerful] I used to play for supper at roadside inns. I know six songs well and about forty badly.

entries.speaker: faelen
entries.shown: [smiling] I still have the lute. I sold the feathered hat. A man has to improve himself somehow.
entries.text: [smiling] I still have the lute. I sold the feathered hat. A man has to improve himself somehow.

entries.speaker: faelen
entries.shown: [amused] Cruel, but fair. I will play you the good six. You can request the others after enough wine.
entries.text: [amused] Cruel, but fair. I will play you the good six. You can request the others after enough wine.

entries.speaker: faelen
entries.shown: [pleased] I was hoping you might say that. Let us have a little time together and see how we get on.
entries.text: [pleased] I was hoping you might say that. Let us have a little time together and see how we get on.

entries.speaker: faelen
entries.shown: [easy] All right. Let me know if you want to try again. No awkwardness between us.
entries.text: [easy] All right. Let me know if you want to try again. No awkwardness between us.

entries.speaker: faelen
entries.shown: [smiling] I like you. I'd like to spend an evening with you, without the rest of this lot.
entries.text: [smiling] I like you. I'd like to spend an evening with you, without the rest of this lot.
entries.before: [smiling] So. I flirt with everything. Trees. Wyverns. That doorman. You have noticed.

entries.speaker: faelen
entries.shown: [delighted] Excellent. A decent meal, some wine, and no work.
entries.text: [delighted] Excellent. A decent meal, some wine, and no work.
entries.before: [delighted] Do not stop. Understood. Written down. Framed.

entries.speaker: faelen
entries.shown: [warm] I have been looking forward to this.
entries.text: [warm] I have been looking forward to this.
entries.before: [soft] Thank you. I will be insufferable about this for years.

entries.speaker: nettle
entries.shown: [quiet] So this is the mine.
entries.text: [quiet] So this is the mine.
entries.before: [quiet] So. The hole in the hill.

entries.speaker: nettle
entries.shown: [hard] For two years, I have watched the river get worse. Dead fish, sick animals. All because of this place.
entries.text: [hard] For two years, I have watched the river get worse. Dead fish, sick animals. All because of this place.
entries.before: [hard] Two years I have smelled this water and never once stood where it starts. It is smaller than I made it in my head.

entries.speaker: nettle
entries.shown: [firm] I want this mine shut before we leave.
entries.text: [firm] I want this mine shut before we leave.
entries.before: [flat] Good. Small things can be closed.

entries.speaker: halvard
entries.shown: [precise] The Consortium is hiring swords. Go in as hired guards and search the top-floor offices. We need the orders bearing Adigun's seal.
entries.text: [precise] The Consortium is hiring swords. Go in as hired guards and search the top-floor offices. We need the orders bearing Adigun's seal.
entries.before: [precise] The Consortium is hiring swords. You walk in the front door as swords. The ledgers are on the top floor with three men who never leave it.

entries.speaker: halvard
entries.shown: [grave] The keepers hold shipping records both kingdoms trust. They are hearing the dispute over the iron shortage. Take Adigun's orders to Lanternhold and show them who caused it.
entries.text: [grave] The keepers hold shipping records both kingdoms trust. They are hearing the dispute over the iron shortage. Take Adigun's orders to Lanternhold and show them who caused it.
entries.before: [grave] Then you go to Lanternhold. The keep takes a book as its toll; here is one worth the toll. Do not lose it.

entries.speaker: halvard
entries.shown: [quiet] I will have my officers keep looking for Kolade here. His father may know where he is. Question Adigun, and bring him back alive if you can. This book will pay your way into the keep.
entries.text: [quiet] I will have my officers keep looking for Kolade here. His father may know where he is. Question Adigun, and bring him back alive if you can. This book will pay your way into the keep.
entries.before: [quiet] Find them. Bring me proof I can read to the Council. And {target} — whatever they are hiding about you, I would rather you heard it from a friend than from them.

entries.speaker: sarn
entries.shown: [low] Adigun Adeyinka is my father. Those orders from the mine carry his seal. He and his partners have gone to Lanternhold for a hearing over the iron shortage. He means to persuade the keepers that Calder is to blame.
entries.text: [low] Adigun Adeyinka is my father. Those orders from the mine carry his seal. He and his partners have gone to Lanternhold for a hearing over the iron shortage. He means to persuade the keepers that Calder is to blame.
entries.before: [low] Adigun Adeyinka is my father. He runs this office. Those orders from the mine carry his seal, and he has gone to Lanternhold to secure the keepers' support. The papers upstairs will prove it.

entries.speaker: amara
entries.shown: [quiet] You kept your word. Thank you for letting me help.
entries.text: [quiet] You kept your word. Thank you for letting me help.

entries.speaker: amara
entries.shown: [quiet] Yes. Kolade has lied to me too. I know he has hurt people. I still care for him, but I cannot let him go on killing.
entries.text: [quiet] Yes. Kolade has lied to me too. I know he has hurt people. I still care for him, but I cannot let him go on killing.
entries.before: [quiet] He lied to keep you. Kolade has never lied to anyone in his life; it is not the same thing, and I think you know it. But yes. It counts. It means you can hear me.

needsCasting.speaker: thornwise
needsCasting.shown: [old, unhurried] Wanjiru. They have been told to leave.

needsCasting.speaker: thornwise
needsCasting.shown: [flat] I have buried nine of ours since that mine opened. If these people work for the Consortium, they will get no mercy from me.

needsCasting.speaker: thornwise
needsCasting.shown: [cold] Hear them out if you must. They stay where they are.

needsCasting.speaker: thornwise
needsCasting.shown: [flat, from the trees] Wanjiru. If they are lying, you are the one who let them in.

needsCasting.speaker: thornwise
needsCasting.shown: [grudging] Go with them, then. Make sure they shut that mine. I expect you back when it is done.
